ALDER WINDOW MODULES — SIGNED SUPPLY AGREEMENT
Parties: Fernbridge Tableworks Ltd. (Buyer) and Cinder Vale Display Ltd. (Supplier).
Agreement date: 2 July 2026. Project: AW-73. Currency: CAD. All prices include applicable taxes.
1. Price for three finished display modules: $12,600. Deposit: $4,200 on signing. Stage-two instalment: $4,200 on Buyer's written approval of the full-size prototype. Final instalment: $4,200 on Buyer's signed acceptance after delivery and joint inspection.
2. Prototype approval permits manufacture; it is not acceptance of the finished modules. A delivery docket records delivery only. Supplier must offer a joint inspection within seven calendar days after delivery.
3. Buyer may identify transit or finish defects for review at that inspection. Any additional storage charge requires a separate written quotation accepted by Buyer.
9. A party requesting a contractual remedy must give written notice identifying the breach and allow ten calendar days after receipt for the other party to respond and arrange a joint review. This clause sets no five-business-day payment deadline or automatic acceleration of instalments.
Signed for Buyer: A. Marr, operations lead — 2 July 2026.
Signed for Supplier: S. Pike, director — 2 July 2026.

ALDER WINDOW MODULES — PARTIAL CUSTOMER ACCOUNT EXPORT
Supplier export generated 10 September 2026 at 08:15. Customer: Fernbridge Tableworks Ltd. Currency: CAD.
Scope warning: transaction rows dated 2 July to 8 September only. Opening balance, earlier credit notes and complete invoice history are not included. Invoice CV-577 belongs to an earlier project, not AW-73.
2 July: transfer $4,200 cleared; allocated to AW-73 deposit invoice CV-601.
4 August: transfer $2,100 cleared; originally allocated to AW-73 stage-two invoice CV-611. Bank narrative: "AW73 stage payment".
6 August: internal journal removes the 4 August receipt from CV-611 and allocates $2,100 to old invoice CV-577. Journal note: "oldest open item per accounts". No buyer instruction is attached.
7 August: second transfer $2,100 provisionally posted to CV-611.
9 August: bank return BR-809 reverses the 7 August transfer in full; bank reason: duplicate-payment recall. Net cleared amount from that transfer: $0.
8 September: CV-611 stage-two face value $4,200; CV-619 final face value $4,200. This export does not show an opening customer balance, all credits or a reconciled closing balance. It does not contain a storage invoice.

ALDER WINDOW MODULES — CORRESPONDENCE AND DELIVERY RECORD
12 August 2026, Buyer to Supplier: I approve the full-size prototype for manufacture under AW-73. This is written stage-two approval. I do not yet accept the finished modules.
13 August 2026, Buyer to Supplier accounts: Our $2,100 transfer of 4 August was for AW-73. Why have you moved it to CV-577? We dispute that old invoice and say an earlier credit is missing. Please send a complete account. The duplicate 7 August transfer was recalled; do not count it as an extra payment.
14 August 2026, Supplier accounts to Buyer: We applied the first transfer to the oldest open item. We will investigate the claimed old credit. We have not completed that review.
31 August 2026, carrier docket AW73-D: Three wrapped modules delivered to Buyer's loading area. Signed "received, subject to inspection" by warehouse assistant M. Vale. No acceptance certificate is attached.
1 September 2026, Buyer to Supplier: Two packages have crushed corners and a visible finish chip. Please arrange the contract inspection. We have not signed acceptance. These are preliminary observations, not a final rejection of all three modules.
2 September 2026, Supplier to Buyer: The prototype was approved and we believe the finished units conform. We can inspect on 8 September. Our warehouse incurred $450 holding cost before dispatch; we will seek that amount.
3 September 2026, Buyer to Supplier: 8 September works. Send the storage quotation you say we accepted; we have no record of one.
9 September 2026, Buyer internal note: No inspection report or signed acceptance is in our file. The planned 8 September visit may have been rescheduled; check both diaries before stating whether it happened.
10 September 2026, Supplier mail log: demand email submitted for delivery at 09:02; status "delivery pending — remote server retry". No delivery confirmation, read acknowledgment or later retry result is included.

documents.title: Demand
documents.text:
PAYMENT AND REMEDY DEMAND — ALDER WINDOW MODULES
From: Cinder Vale Display Ltd. To: Fernbridge Tableworks Ltd.
Dated and emailed: 10 September 2026. Project: AW-73.
The contract price is $12,600. We credit only the $4,200 deposit to AW-73 and demand $8,400 for the remaining instalments, plus $450 storage, total $8,850. Your 4 August payment was applied to your older account. The 7 August payment was reversed. Our account review remains open.
You approved the prototype on 12 August and received the modules on 31 August. We treat that delivery as acceptance. You have mentioned damage, which we do not admit. We have no signed final acceptance certificate to enclose.
Under clause 9, payment and your response are required within five business days of receipt. On the basis of this email being sent today, we calculate the deadline as Thursday, 17 September 2026. If the amount is not paid by then, we intend to pursue recovery and other remedies.
No accepted storage quotation, completed inspection report, complete customer reconciliation or confirmed demand receipt is enclosed.
